inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: An observed classroom that children have access to has missing floor tiles.    This was corrected during the inspection when the director placed a rug over the area with the missing tiles.  A request has also been submitted for the new floor tiles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): A caregiver file did not have a completed pre- employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): One of the caregiver files did not have a notarized affidavit form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: Two affidavit forms and a hands on CPR training certificate was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Three of the children's files did not have the date of admission.    This standard was corrected during the inspection when the operation provided the date of admission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the reviewed children files did not have the updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There is a drain cover with a large hole torn in it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: A reviewed child's file did not have the completed water activity permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was present in the classroom with a pending background check.    This was corrected when the caregiver was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: A child on the allergy list does not have a food allergy plan completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The operation was not able to provide the certificate of completion including all of the requirements such as the trainer's qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: A reviewed child's file did not have the completed water activity permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a large hole that could cause a tripping hazard in the outdoor playground area. There is also a drain cover with a large hole torn in it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special School-age Permissions: A reviewed school age child's file did not have transportation permission completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: Two children with known food allergies did not have completed food allergy plans or required medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three of the caregivers had cpr trainings that expired on 6.25, 8.25, and 1.25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: During an inspection, Child Care Regulation (CCR) did not have access to review personnel files at the operation to ensure that 5 of 8 staff had required annual training and to ensure that 3 of 4 staff had required transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Three of the reviewed school age children files did not have the school information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not make a report when a child was left alone for a few seconds in the front foyer of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide an incident report for a child that was placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when leaving a child alone in the front foyer for a few seconds the child had access to the front door and an open parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operations classrooms have been out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director failed to actively monitor and maintain the operations adherence to all necessary regulations and safety standards set by the relevant licensing body, in the area of ratio and staffing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: The operation had a mixed age group classroom with infants and school age children in the same classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant classroom is not updating the infant feeding instructions every 30 days as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 5 out of 9 caregivers did not have all of the required annual training topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have all of  the required annual training topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The caregiver could not visually see all of the children on the playground at her post.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was unsupervised for approximately 7-8 minutes after being left on the playground without the caregiver?s knowledge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to notify Licensing that a child was left on a playground without their caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver was observed hitting a child on her buttocks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to notify Licensing of a situation that placed a child in harm's way.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A caregiver disciplined children by use of corporal punishment.  A caregiver threatened to withhold active play, use of a belt and to take a child to the restroom to address discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The two infant classrooms are not updating the infant feeding instructions as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Storage: The operation could not provide a child's full record upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Storage (26 TAC §746.803(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: During the inspection I observed that the child did not  wash their hands after a diaper change.     Corrected:  The child was instructed to wash her hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: During the inspection I observed that the caregiver did not conduct handwashing  between diaper changes.     Corrected:  The caregiver washed her hands after changing the diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: The times of the diaper changes and feeding times were not accurately documented on infant daily reports.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of ten children records evaluated were missing current immunization records on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director has completed twenty one out of thirty hours of annual training for the last annual training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The cots in the preschool and pre-k classrooms were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The walls in the infant, toddler, and school age classrooms were chipped in multiple areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One out of eight caregivers did not have documentation showing the written and hands on portion of the CPR certification was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed with direct access to 11 children in a classroom during the inspection. The operation has not obtained an eligibility notification from CBCU.    Note: The caregiver left the classroom during the inspection. It was discussed that until the background check results come back from CBCU caregivers cannot have direct access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: Children were observed climbing on top of the tables during the walk through and there was no activity schedule posted in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation has not had an annual fire marshal inspection conducted since April of 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: In infant A classroom five infants and in infant B three infants didn't have an updated feeding instruction form on file. The feed instruction forms were from December of 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The operation didn't have documentation of their most recent fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)
